D: Batman takes on the Penguin and Catwoman at Christmas time.
P: Serve the snacks when the Gotham Christmas tree lights up.
S: Dark rye fingers with smoked salmon, crème fraîche, capers and dill
Dark rye buttered, topped with smoked salmon, crème fraîche, capers and dill, cut into fingers.
a little fish for the cat in the house

Whitebait tossed in seasoned flour and fried shatteringly crisp, with lemon, chilli salt and a black garlic aioli, piled high in paper cones. Rinse and pat dry 500g whitebait. Toss in 100g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika, salt and pepper and shake off the excess. Fry in batches at 190C for 2 minutes until crisp. Mash 2 cloves black garlic into 120g mayo with a squeeze of lemon. Toss the whitebait with chilli salt and serve in paper cones with lemon wedges and the aioli.
Chestnuts roasted until the shells curl, peeled warm and salted
Score chestnuts with a cross, soak 20 minutes, roast at 220C for 20 minutes until the shells curl, wrap in a towel 5 minutes, peel warm.
M: Crackling pork loin with roast potatoes and chunky sage apple sauce
Pork loin with crackling: score and dry the skin overnight, salt, roast at 240C for 30 minutes then 180C to 63C inside. Apple and sage sauce, roast potatoes.
his lair under the Gotham Zoo

Flathead in a crisp beer batter with double-fried chips, minty mushy peas and caper tartare, wrapped in newspaper like a Red Triangle Circus handbill. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Simmer 400g frozen peas 4 minutes, then mash with 30g butter and chopped mint. Whisk 150g plain flour and 50g cornflour with 300ml cold lager. Dip 700g flathead fillets in flour, then batter, and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayo with capers, gherkins and lemon for tartare.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with buttercream, a sugar tree and coconut snow
Vanilla cupcakes with white buttercream, a tiny sugar Christmas tree on top and shredded coconut snow.
K: Brandy, cold milk and vanilla shaken cold, with grated nutmeg
Brandy, milk, sugar syrup and vanilla shaken with ice, strained into a coupe, grated nutmeg on top.

steps.text: Butter the rye.
Top with creme fraiche, smoked salmon, a few capers and dill sprigs.
Cut into fingers with a sharp knife and serve cold on a dark plate.

veg.make_ahead: Beetroot up to 1 day ahead, assemble up to 2 hours ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the beetroot paper thin and toss with the lemon juice, smoked paprika and salt. Leave for 10 minutes.
Butter the rye.
Top with creme fraiche, folds of beetroot, a few capers and dill sprigs.
Cut into fingers with a sharp knife and serve cold on a dark plate.

dishes.make_ahead: Cut a cross in each chestnut up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; soak and roast just before serving

steps.text: Cut a cross into each chestnut and soak in water.
Roast at 220C until the shells curl back.
Wrap in a tea towel to steam.
Peel while warm and sprinkle with flaky salt.

dishes.make_ahead: Dry the pork the night before

steps.text: Score the pork and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Salt well and roast at 240C to start the crackling.
Drop to 180C and roast until 63C inside, adding the potatoes tossed in oil alongside.
Meanwhile cook the apples with sage and a little sugar to a chunky sauce.
Rest the pork before carving.

veg.make_ahead: Apple sauce up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin lengthways, scoop out the seeds and score the flesh in a deep criss-cross.
Rub with half the oil, the salt and some chopped sage, then roast at 220C cut side up.
Add the potatoes tossed in the rest of the oil and roast until the pumpkin is tender and the edges are crisp.
Meanwhile cook the apples with a little sage and the sugar to a chunky sauce.
Fry the rest of the sage leaves in the butter until crisp and pour over the pumpkin before carving.
Heat the oven to 180C and line a 12-hole tin. Beat half the butter with the sugar, then the eggs.
Fold in the flour and milk, divide between the cases and bake.
Cool completely.
Beat the rest of the butter with the icing sugar and ice the cupcakes.
Add a sugar tree and shredded coconut snow to each.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the brandy, milk, sugar syrup and vanilla in a bottle up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; shake with ice and strain to order

steps.text: Shake the brandy, milk, sugar syrup and vanilla hard with ice, a drink at a time.
Strain into chilled coupes and grate nutmeg over the top.

af.make_ahead: Steep and cool the tea, then mix with the milk, sugar syrup and vanilla up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; shake with ice and strain to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Shake the cold tea, milk, sugar syrup and vanilla hard with ice, a drink at a time.
Strain into chilled coupes and grate nutmeg over the top.

s.note: Dark rye fingers with smoked salmon, crème fraîche, capers and dill
s.how: Butter 6 slices dark rye bread. Top with 200g smoked salmon, a spoon of crème fraîche, a few capers and dill sprigs. Cut into fingers with a sharp knife and serve cold on a dark plate.

s.note: Chestnuts roasted until the shells curl, peeled warm and salted
s.how: Cut a cross into 500g chestnuts and soak in water for 20 minutes. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes until the shells curl back. Wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes, then peel warm and sprinkle with flaky salt.

m.note: Crackling pork loin with roast potatoes and chunky sage apple sauce
m.how: Score a 1.5kg pork loin and dry uncovered overnight. Salt well and roast at 240C for 30 minutes, then 180C until 63C inside. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Cook 3 apples with sage and a little sugar to a chunky sauce.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with buttercream, a sugar tree and coconut snow
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Ice with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar, then add a sugar tree and shredded coconut snow.

d.note: Brandy, cold milk and vanilla shaken cold, with grated nutmeg
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml brandy, 90ml cold milk, 15ml sugar syrup and a drop of vanilla hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and grate nutmeg over the top. Makes four.
